purpose: Separate response of the prepared fluid from ongoing state-dependent forcing feedback.
restart: Exact saved full initial branch states, pulses and observation coordinates of the forced experiment; turn off only the continuing forcing for horizon 0.4.
grids: Both effective production grids; first seed additionally half-step at finer grid.
same_pulse_control: Additionally repeat the same-pulse equal-work/equal-strength intervention with sustaining force off on the same seeds/grids and half-step subset. Identical prepared states and impulses are preserved; both unprobed and probed branches are rerun with forcing off.
inference: Paired two-flow exploratory control. Do not treat as independent confirmation or infer absence of feedback from a nonsignificant difference.
